headline: Sugarfish
title: Sugarfish | Freeze Stone Fork | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Sugarfish is a stage one Ice Aniimo. At level sixty two it evolves with one Freeze Stone, and the line splits into Sugarslime or Sugartini. Sugary Gravity costs twenty energy, deals power fifty two and has an eighteen second cooldown. Sugar-Rush Tackle has power thirty. Homeland work is Ice, Leisure and Hauling at level one. Plan your stone before you level it. Which evolution would you pick? Comment below!
description: Sugarfish guide: a stage 1 Ice Aniimo that evolves at Lv. 62 with a Freeze Stone into Sugarslime or Sugartini. Sugary Gravity (power 52) and Sugar-Rush Tackle skills. Checked on aniimo.gg and metabot.gg in November 2026.
joke: Sugarfish is sweet, but it still hates sunny days.
